summary: Robert Evans, Katy Stoll and Cody Johnston keep reading Ben Shapiro's 2016 novel True Allegiance, mocking its prose and a plot of a militia standoff, a staged police killing that sparks a Detroit riot, and Islamist villains in Tehran.

evidence.note: Bundy-style rancher standoff: militia guards her ranch against a federal SWAT team
chapter ends with SWAT officers burning to death after a helicopter crash, read aloud
gang leader pays a Black child to provoke a cop so his killing can spark unrest; hosts call it racist
rally in Detroit turns into a riot with firebombs, then stops on the reverend's cue
chapter moves to an Islamist leader's compound in Tehran after the US falls
hosts critique the novel's Islamophobic, muddled picture of Iran, al-Qaeda and Saddam's WMDs
captured general is filmed for a jihadist hostage video in Tehran

notes: Part of the multi-episode reading of True Allegiance. Time is the novel's 2016 publication and its unspecified near-present setting (approximate). Iran setting is fictional (the terrorist plot and hostage scenes). propaganda-media chosen as closest primary theme, matching sibling records; no theme fits right-wing polemical fiction exactly. Character spellings are approximate from the transcript.
